_note: Fees, processing times and office names are taken from the Roxas City Citizen's Charter, 4th Edition (2023). Entries marked "verified": false are services the charter does not cover; their fee and processing time read "Not published" rather than carrying an unsourced estimate. See UNVERIFIED-CONTENT.md in the repository root.

services.title: Birth Certificate
services.description: Get a certified copy of birth certificate registered in Roxas City
services.office: City Civil Registrar's Office – Archives Division
services.sourceRef: Civil Registrar IV. Certification / certified machine copy (p.173); registration of birth itself is free (p.168)

services.title: Marriage Certificate
services.description: Register or request certified true copy of marriage certificate
services.office: City Civil Registrar's Office – Archives Division
services.sourceRef: Civil Registrar IV. Certification / certified machine copy (p.173). A new marriage licence costs ₱500 (local applicants) or ₱3,000 (foreign national) plus a ₱100 licence fee, with a 10-day posting period (p.171)

services.title: Death Certificate
services.description: Register death certificate and obtain burial or transfer permit
services.fee: Free to register; ₱50 burial/transfer fee payable to the City Health Office
services.office: City Civil Registrar's Office – Archives Division
services.sourceRef: Civil Registrar II. Registration of death (p.169); City Health Office III. Sanitation services – burial/transfer permit (p.119)

services.title: Barangay Clearance
services.description: Certificate of residence from your barangay
services.sourceNote: Barangay clearances are issued by the 47 individual barangays, not by a city office. The Citizen's Charter does not cover barangay-level services and no city-wide schedule of barangay fees is published.

services.title: Barangay ID
services.description: Official barangay identification card
services.sourceNote: Barangay IDs are issued by the individual barangays. The Citizen's Charter does not cover barangay-level services.

services.title: Police Clearance
services.description: Police clearance coordination through city office
services.sourceNote: Police clearance is issued by the PNP, a national agency. It is not a city service and is not in the Citizen's Charter.

services.title: Business Permit (New)
services.description: Apply for a new mayor's permit to operate a business
services.fee: Varies — assessed on capitalisation/gross receipts and the nature of the business
services.office: City Treasurer's Office – Business Permit & Licensing Division
services.sourceRef: BPLD I. Issuance of business permit (p.27)

services.title: Business Permit Renewal
services.description: Renew your annual business permit
services.fee: Varies — assessed on capitalisation/gross receipts and the nature of the business
services.office: City Treasurer's Office – Business Permit & Licensing Division
services.sourceRef: BPLD I. Issuance of business permit (p.27)

services.title: Business Closure
services.description: File for business closure/termination
services.fee: ₱100 (certification of no business / retired / closed business)
services.office: City Treasurer's Office – Business Permit & Licensing Division
services.sourceRef: BPLD III. Issuance of certified copy/ies of business permit & certification (p.32)

services.title: Sanitary Permit
services.description: Health and sanitation permit for businesses
services.office: City Health Office – Environmental Health Section
services.sourceRef: City Health Office I. Sanitation services – sanitary permit (p.115)

services.title: Community Tax Certificate (Cedula)
services.description: Obtain cedula for individuals and businesses
services.fee: ₱1 for every ₱1,000 of annual gross income
services.sourceRef: City Treasurer V. Securing community tax certificate, individual (p.92)

services.title: Senior Citizen ID
services.description: ID card and benefits for citizens 60 years and above
services.fee: Free for a new ID; ₱100 for a replacement or lost ID
services.sourceRef: OSCA I. Issuance of senior citizens' I.D. cards (p.35)

services.title: PWD ID & Services
services.description: ID and benefits for persons with disabilities
services.sourceNote: Not listed as a frontline service in the Citizen's Charter, 4th Edition. No fee or processing time is published.

services.title: Financial Assistance
services.description: Emergency financial aid for qualified residents
services.sourceRef: AICS Unit I. Aid to Individuals in Crisis Situation (p.39)

services.title: Burial Assistance
services.description: Financial assistance for burial expenses
services.sourceNote: Not listed separately in the Citizen's Charter. Burial help is handled case by case under Aid to Individuals in Crisis Situation (AICS).

services.title: Solo Parent ID
services.description: ID and benefits for solo parents
services.sourceNote: Not listed as a frontline service in the Citizen's Charter, 4th Edition. No fee or processing time is published.

services.title: Vaccination Programs
services.description: Free immunization for children and adults
services.office: City Health Office – Family Health & Nutrition Section
services.sourceRef: City Health Office X. National Immunization Program (p.132)

services.title: Health Certificate
services.description: Medical certificate for employment or business
services.office: City Health Office – Environmental Health Section
services.sourceRef: City Health Office VI. Health certificate (p.124)

services.title: Medical Assistance
services.description: Financial aid for medical expenses and hospitalization
services.sourceNote: Not listed separately in the Citizen's Charter. Medical help is handled case by case under Aid to Individuals in Crisis Situation (AICS).

services.title: Prenatal Checkup
services.description: Free prenatal care for pregnant women
services.office: City Health Office – Birthing Facilities Section
services.sourceRef: City Health Office XII. Prenatal (p.136)

services.title: Real Property Tax Payment
services.description: Pay annual real property tax (amilyar)
services.fee: Varies — the tax due as assessed
services.sourceRef: City Treasurer II. Payment of real property tax (p.84)

services.title: Business Tax Payment
services.description: Pay quarterly or annual business taxes
services.fee: Varies — the tax due as assessed
services.sourceRef: City Treasurer III. Payment of business tax (p.87)

services.title: Tax Clearance
services.description: Certificate of no tax liability
services.sourceRef: City Treasurer IV. Securing real property tax clearance certificate (p.89)

services.title: Agricultural Loans
services.description: Low-interest loans for farmers
services.sourceRef: City Agriculture III. Accessing technical assistance on plan and budget preparation for crop production loan (p.154)

services.title: Crop Insurance
services.description: Insurance coverage for crop damage
services.sourceRef: City Agriculture I. Free crop insurance for farmers (p.150)

services.title: Fertilizer Assistance
services.description: Free or subsidized fertilizer for registered farmers
services.sourceNote: Not listed as a frontline service in the Citizen's Charter, 4th Edition. Input subsidies run as time-limited programmes with no published standing fee or processing time.

services.title: Building Permit
services.description: Permit for new construction or renovation
services.fee: Varies — assessed under the National Building Code
services.sourceRef: City Engineer I. Processing of application for building permit (p.106)

services.title: Occupancy Permit
services.description: Certificate of completion for new buildings
services.fee: Varies — assessed under the National Building Code
services.sourceRef: City Engineer II. Processing of application for certificate of occupancy (p.109)

services.title: Road Maintenance Request
services.description: Report road damage or request repairs
services.sourceNote: Not listed as a frontline service in the Citizen's Charter, 4th Edition. No published request procedure or turnaround time.

services.title: Scholarship Programs
services.description: Financial assistance for students
services.sourceNote: Not listed as a frontline service in the Citizen's Charter, 4th Edition. Scholarship terms are set per programme and per year and are not published as a standing service.

services.title: Student Assistance
services.description: Educational grants and allowances
services.sourceNote: Not listed as a frontline service in the Citizen's Charter, 4th Edition. No published fee or processing time.

services.title: Emergency Response
services.description: 24/7 emergency assistance and rescue
services.sourceRef: CDRRMO I. Response to emergency calls (p.46)

services.title: Disaster Preparedness
services.description: Training and resources for disaster readiness
services.sourceNote: Not a frontline service in the Citizen's Charter. The CDRRMO entries cover emergency response (17 minutes) and issuance of certificates (3 working days) only.

services.title: Environmental Clearance
services.description: Environmental compliance certificate for projects
services.sourceNote: An Environmental Compliance Certificate is issued by DENR-EMB, a national agency, not by the city. Not in the Citizen's Charter.

services.title: Tree Cutting Permit
services.description: Permit to cut or trim trees
services.sourceNote: Tree-cutting permits are issued by DENR, a national agency. Not in the Citizen's Charter.

services.title: SEEDO Slaughterhouse
services.description: Hog, cattle, goat, and carabao slaughter with meat inspection services
services.sourceNote: Not listed as a frontline service in the Citizen's Charter, 4th Edition. No slaughterhouse fee schedule for Roxas City is published.

services.title: CSWDO Services
services.description: Social case studies, indigency certificates, AICS, PWD and senior citizen assistance
services.processingTime: Varies by service — 2 hours to several months
services.sourceRef: CSWDO I–XV frontline services (pp.183–217)

services.title: Waste Management Services
services.description: Garbage collection and disposal services
services.sourceNote: Not listed as a frontline service in the Citizen's Charter, 4th Edition. No published collection schedule or fee.

services.title: SEEDO Public Market
services.description: Market clearance, entrance fees, vendor services, and CTC issuance
services.sourceNote: Not listed as a frontline service in the Citizen's Charter, 4th Edition. No market stall/entrance fee schedule for Roxas City is published.

services.title: Business Permits & Licensing Office
services.description: New permits, renewals, Mayor's clearance, and other business permits
services.fee: Varies — assessed on capitalisation/gross receipts and the nature of the business
services.office: City Treasurer's Office – Business Permit & Licensing Division
services.sourceRef: BPLD I–III (pp.27–34)

services.title: Tricycle Franchising & Records
services.description: Apply for tricycle franchise (MTOF) and request records
services.fee: ₱385 regular franchise / ₱240 special franchise; ₱52 change-motor fee + ₱12 unit-conversion fee
services.office: City Mayor's Office – Tricycle Franchising & Regulatory Unit (TFRU)
services.sourceRef: TFRU I–II (pp.50–54)

services.title: City Treasurer's Office
services.description: Tax collection, cedula, clearances, and payment services
services.sourceRef: City Treasurer I–V (pp.82–94)

services.title: City Budget Office
services.description: Obligation requests, barangay budget review, and SEF budget preparation
services.sourceRef: City Budget Office I. Preliminary review of barangay/SK annual and supplemental budget (p.221)

services.title: City Accounting Office
services.description: Pre-audit of disbursements, payroll, check issuance, and financial reporting
services.sourceRef: City Accountant I–III, internal services (pp.229–235)

services.title: Property Declaration
services.description: Declaration of land, building and machineries for tax assessment
services.sourceRef: City Assessor II. Issuance of tax declaration for change or transfer of ownership (p.96)

services.title: City Assessor's Office
services.description: Property assessment, tax declaration, and land records
services.sourceRef: City Assessor IV. Issuance of certification/certified true copy of tax declaration (p.103)

services.title: Local Civil Registrar
services.description: Birth, marriage, death certificates and civil registry services
services.sourceRef: Civil Registrar I–VII (pp.168–182)

services.title: City Engineering Office
services.description: Building permits, infrastructure projects, and engineering services
services.fee: Varies — assessed under the National Building Code
services.sourceRef: City Engineer I–III (pp.106–114)

services.title: City Planning & Development Office
services.description: Zoning, land use, development permits, and planning services
services.sourceRef: CPDO I–II (pp.145–149)

services.title: City Agriculture Office
services.description: Agricultural assistance, farm registration, and livelihood programs
services.sourceRef: City Agriculture I–X (pp.150–165)

services.title: General Services Office
services.description: Property management, vehicle maintenance, and general city services
services.sourceNote: The City General Services Office has no external frontline service in the Citizen's Charter, 4th Edition.

services.title: Human Resource Management Office
services.description: Employment, personnel records, and HR services
services.sourceNote: The Human Resource Management Office has no external frontline service in the Citizen's Charter, 4th Edition.

services.title: Business Online Billing & Payment
services.description: View and pay your business tax bills online via Filipizen
services.sourceNote: The Filipizen portal is live, but no processing time for online billing and payment is published in the Citizen's Charter.

services.title: Business Permit Renewal Online
services.description: Renew your existing business permit online via Filipizen

services.sourceRef: BPLD I. Issuance of business permit (p.27)

services.description: View and pay your real property tax (amilyar) online via Filipizen
services.sourceNote: The Filipizen portal is live, but no processing time for online billing and payment is published in the Citizen's Charter.

services.description: Process payment orders for various city fees online via Filipizen
services.sourceNote: The Filipizen portal is live, but no processing time for online payment orders is published in the Citizen's Charter.
